Initialize optional TG_SIZE after enabled TGID registers; include TG_SIZE, append mode and LDS size in compute specialization identity. Hardware validation remains pending.
Isolate capture caches and skip shader binary, metadata and pipeline persistence for incomplete capture variants. Keep stable Info ownership for every normal/capture permutation.
Preserve guest LDS in storage with storage-buffer memory semantics; retain upstream divergence-aware barrier insertion; reject capture when a later workgroup barrier could strand waves.
Port new BufferCache API and access masks, reserve three capture descriptors in bounded uniform-store discovery, reject incompatible wave/subgroup/scratch state.

Explicit one-shot capture saves bounded original GPU packets and first 32 register checkpoints before complete checkpoint validation; runner archives up to two files of at most 4 MiB with hashes. Completion is never claimed from file existence.
Shader binary/meta cache versions advance to 16/9; update existing metadata version contract. No new emulator tests committed.
